verdict.rationale: Gitleaks is a CLI that runs headlessly over git repos, directories, or stdin. It installs via Docker, Homebrew, or Go, and the first-party gitleaks-action runs scans automatically on pull requests and commits in GitHub workflows. Baseline support writes a findings.json containing only new issues, which suits CI gating. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of exit codes and report formats for CI pass/fail gating, and independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Enable **Gitleaks-Action** in your GitHub workflows to be alerted when secrets are leaked as soon as they happen.
You can use it to automatically run a gitleaks scan on all your team's pull requests and commits, or run on-demand scans.
Gitleaks can be installed using Homebrew, Docker, or Go.
After running the detect command with the --baseline-path parameter, report output (findings.json) will only contain new issues.
